the tail distribution of age of data is a power law and the exponent is a function of the system parameters.

the analysis of data backup systems, and the age of data is a critical performance measure.
the analysis of the age of backup data in cloud infrastructures.

we have analyzed the age of data of the data backup system and have obtained the generating function and the asymptotic behavior of its distribution.
